title: Delivery-App Spend vs Walkable Alternatives
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn category=delivery_food
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(amount) as delivery_spend, count as orders, avg(distance_km) as avg_distance by _time
| sort - _time
description: Highlights how much is being spent on convenience orders that may have an easy local alternative.
value: Delivery spend often feels like a lifestyle choice until the weekly total makes the premium obvious.
implementation: Categorise food-delivery transactions and track delivery distance when available; review weekly order count and spend.
visualization: Weekly chart of delivery-app spend and order volume.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much money is going on convenience delivery that might have been a quick walk or cheaper local pickup.
